scripts.start: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && electron .
scripts.test: npm run build:desktop && npm run build:tests && node --import ./scripts/ts-build-loader.mjs --test test/*.test.mts
scripts.build:native: mkdir -p native/bin && swiftc -module-cache-path /tmp/fairy-swift-cache native/Desktop.swift -o native/bin/fairy-desktop && swiftc -parse-as-library -module-cache-path /tmp/fairy-swift-cache native/Transcribe.swift -o native/bin/fairy-transcribe && swiftc -O -module-cache-path /tmp/fairy-swift-cache native/QuizOCR.swift -o native/bin/fairy-quiz-ocr && swiftc -module-cache-path /tmp/fairy-swift-cache native/QuizOverlay.swift -o native/bin/fairy-quiz-overlay && swiftc -parse-as-library -module-cache-path /tmp/fairy-swift-cache native/Meeting.swift -o native/bin/fairy-meeting
scripts.package:fairy: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && npm run build:screen && npm run build:idle && npm run build:simulator && npm run build:notch && npm run build:document && npm run build:power && npm run build:quiz && npm run build:guide && npm run build:notes && node build-ts/scripts/package-fairy.mjs
scripts.build:quiz: swiftc -O -module-cache-path /tmp/fairy-swift-cache native/QuizOCR.swift -o native/bin/fairy-quiz-ocr && swiftc -module-cache-path /tmp/fairy-swift-cache native/QuizOverlay.swift -o native/bin/fairy-quiz-overlay
scripts.build:resource-monitor: cargo build --release --manifest-path native/resource-monitor/Cargo.toml --target-dir native/resource-monitor/target && cp native/resource-monitor/target/release/fairy-resource-monitor native/bin/fairy-resource-monitor && chmod +x native/bin/fairy-resource-monitor
